steps.prompt:
First update `.localagent-box/loop-plan.md`, ticking (`- [x]`) every item completed this iteration.
Then evaluate progress. If the goal is fully achieved, output a line exactly: `{{completionMarker}}: true`
Otherwise reply in at most 150 words using exactly this shape:
DONE: <what changed this iteration>
REMAINING: <what is left>
NEXT: <the single next change>
FILES TOUCHED: <comma-separated paths>

Goal: {{goal}}
Iteration: {{iteration}}
